5🏷 Discount Impact & Profitability Analysis

How discount levels correlate with order volume, margin, and average order value.

🔎 37.5% of all transactions carried a discount. Zero-discount transactions form the single largest group, indicating that full-price sales dominate.
🔎 Margin erosion at higher discount bands is clearly visible — the profitability curve drops meaningfully above 10% discount, warranting tighter promotional guardrails.
🔎 Average order value does not consistently increase with larger discounts, suggesting volume uplift from promotions may not fully offset margin compression.

6👥 Customer Behavior & Loyalty Insights

Customer purchasing patterns derived from 31,531 unique customers in the transaction data.

🔎 The average customer makes 1.6 purchases over the period, with a median of 1, indicating most customers are occasional buyers.
🔎 Average customer lifetime revenue is $40.45. A small proportion of high-frequency customers likely contribute disproportionate revenue — a classic Pareto pattern.
🔎 Note: Demographic attributes (age, gender, loyalty status) are not available in the provided data.csv. The analysis above is derived from transaction-level customer IDs only. Linking to a customer dimension table would enable deeper segmentation.
